column1: ...a man to whom we owe a debt of gratitude we can never quite repay, although we're starting by promoting him to Narcotics Detective and presenting him with the LPD's highest honor, the Commendation for Valor...
column2: ……一位我們永遠無法完全回報恩情的人；我們先將他升任緝毒警探，並頒發 LPD 最高榮譽「英勇勳章」……

column1: The award...the promotion...the admiration of the entire city...and the start of a new close friendship...
column2: 榮譽……升遷……全城的敬意……以及一段嶄新親密友誼的開始……

column1: It's a congratulatory letter from the local Kiwotary chapter.
column2: 這是當地 Kiwotary 分會寄來的恭賀信。

column1: No way! You found a murder victim? How did you know he was murdered?
column2: 不會吧！你發現了一名命案受害者？你怎麼知道他是被謀殺的？

column1: Might as well sit back and relax. Lt. Morgan will be sending a car over for you. I'll see you later at the station.
column2: 你不如坐下休息。Morgan 中尉會派車來接你。我們待會兒警局見。

column1: Murder, huh? Just doin' his little bit for population control, I assume.
column2: 謀殺，是嗎？我猜他只是為人口控制盡了一點小力。

column1: Reckless driving, huh? Sounds like something you should get an award for. Get it? Wreck-less driving? Ha!
column2: 危險駕駛，是嗎？聽起來像該頒獎給你的事。懂嗎？「無車禍駕駛」？哈哈！

column1: Congratulations, Bonds. You let a sloppy drunk give you a double-fisted slammer to the back of the head. Maybe you should have cuffed him in the back, huh? Don't worry, the neck brace will be off in 8 or 9 months...
column2: 恭喜你，Bonds。你讓一個醉醺醺的糊塗鬼用雙拳重擊你的後腦。也許你該從後方替他上銬，對吧？別擔心，頸圈八、九個月後就能拆了……

column1: It's Jesse Bains, the Death Angel. He looks very familiar...
column2: 這是 Jesse Bains，死亡天使。他看起來非常眼熟……

column1: Oh! Detective Bonds, this came for you this afternoon. It's from Detective Joe Taber in Chicago. He said it was a picture of Jesse Bains, also known as the Death Angel.
column2: 噢！Bonds 警探，今天下午有人送來這個給你。寄件人是芝加哥的 Joe Taber 警探。他說這是 Jesse Bains 的照片，也就是俗稱的死亡天使。

column1: It's the Death Angel, Jesse Bains.
column2: 這就是死亡天使 Jesse Bains。

column1: Congratulations on a fine game, Mr. Banksten. Would you care to accompany me to my penthouse to discuss a potential business alliance?
column2: 牌局打得漂亮，Banksten 先生。願意陪我到頂樓套房談談可能的生意合作嗎？

column1: This is Jesse Bains's penthouse. You're in the lair of the Death Angel.
column2: 這是 Jesse Bains 的頂樓套房。你現在身在死亡天使的巢穴。
正在將檔案送往本地印表機。
